provenance.format_from_caption: Jan 20th draft, competitive 12 team ppr sf tep
provenance.platform: Sleeper mobile app, 'Draft Complete!' board view (PLAYERS tab) plus TEAM tab roster views
provenance.images_in_series_not_used_as_board: 026979_0-4, 026990_0-4, 027000_0-1 are NOT board portions; they are per-manager TEAM-tab roster lists (11 of 12 managers; MatttyyIce has none). Used only to resolve fields the board hides on traded cells and byes clipped by the UI, never to override a legible board cell.
provenance.owner_name_resolution: Header text is truncated by the app. Full names come from TEAM-tab headers and trade annotations: 'Matttyy…'->'MatttyyIce' (annotations only, no roster view); 'BIGDAD…'->'BIGDADDYTRUMP08' assembled from the overlapping roster headers 'BIGDADDYTR…' and '…DYTRUMP08' plus the annotation 'BIGDA…P08'.
provenance.kicker_placeholder_rule: Per the owner's caption: kickers are placeholders for rookie picks; first K taken = rookie 1.01, second = 1.02, and onward. rookie_pick is assigned by draft order of K cells.
provenance.traded_cell_rendering: A traded pick's cell shows '→<acquirer>' in place of 'POS - TEAM (BYE) R.P'. pick_no for those cells comes from grid position (row=round, column=slot) and was cross-checked against the pick label in the acquirer's roster view for every such cell where a roster view exists.
provenance.bye_reading_rule: Where the board printed complete digits with only the closing paren clipped, e.g. '(11', the bye is recorded as legible. Where only '(1' or '(' was visible, the value is taken from a roster view (source.bye_from) or, if none exists, marked illegible with the partial.
provenance.illegible_note: All illegible cells are in slot 12 (MatttyyIce), the one column with no roster view. Names are legible in all but one (10.12, UI-truncated 'Jacory Croskey-M…'); what is missing is nfl_team/bye on 2 traded-in cells and bye on 5 others.

3_snake_order.finding: Board is a THIRD-ROUND-REVERSAL snake (Sleeper '3RR'): R1 1->12, R2 12->1, R3 12->1, then alternating. Every round from 3 on is the mirror of a naive snake. pick_no is taken from the printed R.P labels, which number picks in actual draft order, so pick_no is unaffected.

5_round_count_vs_rulebook.finding: 30 rounds / 360 picks observed vs 29 slots / 348 implied by the capture's draft_math. The extra round is explained by the 48 kicker placeholders: 360 - 48 = 312 real players = 26 per team, leaving 3 open roster slots per team; the capture's own draft_board_observations already says '12 teams x ~30 rounds'. Not an error in the read; the rulebook's total_picks_if_startup assumption (all 29 slots filled with players) is what does not hold.

6_kicker_placeholders.finding: 48 kickers = exactly 4 rounds x 12 = the 48-pick rookie draft recorded in the capture's rookie_draft block. 13th kicker is Sam Ficken at 10.7 -> 2.01, matching the README note '13th K = 2.01'.
